page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with a historiated woodcut initial at the start of the body; no margin notes. Top: running ornament and printer's flourish above the title block. Blocks in reading order: title block (heads and dedication lines), dedication paragraph, signature line, author name, then body paragraph beginning with woodcut initial. Page number at foot.

main_text.head: GENEROSISS. AC ILLUSTRI DOMINO, DN. GULIELMO-LUDOVICO, Comiti à Nassaw, Cattimelibocorum, Viandæ, Diezii &c. Occiduæ Frisiæ Gubernatori prudentissimo, fortissimo, vigilantissimo:
ILLUSTRIBUS AC GENEROSIS HEROIBUS,
main_text.p: COMITIBUS ET IPSIS NASSOVIÆ &c. FFRI germanis, ac plane sanguine, religione, laudatissimæque gubernationis formâ ac normâ conjunctissimis; dominis ac patronis suis humili animi subjectione colendis, præsentem commentariolum in signum memoriamq; grati animi summæq; reverentiæ, dat, dicat dedicatque, eisque ex animo precatur S. P. Q. P.

OMINES isti, Generosi Comites, vulgò beati existimantur, & revera sunt, qui & animi & corporis dotibus sunt quàm ornatissimi, quorum virtuti fortunaque, sive, ut magis theologicè loquar, pietati felicitas conjuncta est, resq; prospere procedunt.
